text: Nindowari Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Nindowari Type: Archaeological Site - Settlement Province: Balochistan District: Khuzdar Period: Proto Historic Relative Chronology: 56,00 BCE - 3500 BCE Description: The chalcolithic site of Nindowari is situated close to village Nindowari towards south from Khuzdar. The site is approached through rudimentary road leading from national high way at about forty km towards west in agricultural zone of ornach valley. It measures 260 x 366 m with maximum height of about 9.1 m. In all there are four ancient mounds, which are almost homogeneous in character. The French archaeological Mission headed by J.M. Casal excavated here for four seasons from 1962 to 1966. (Makin Khan 2019:80-84).
